WASD move (double-tap = sprint) · J call/pass (double-tap: lofted) / head-clear a cross · L cross (hold it longer for a man further across; double-tap: a low driven cross), CLEAR in your own half (or SLIDE when they have the ball) · J / SPACE switch player (towards the way you're pushing), or click a team-mate · with the ball (or with it on its way to you: first time), click a team-mate to pass to him · J with it on its way: one-touch pass · hold the mouse and draw for a skill move, read against the way he's going (a flick ahead = flick, back = drag-back, L = croqueta, circle = roulette, hook = Cruyff turn, back then ahead = rainbow, ahead then back = sombrero, out and back = elastico, loop then a line = heel flick; a player's stars say which he can do) · K shoot (hold K+Up/Down to curl) / header left: drag to move (double-tap sprint) · big button = TRAP / CALL / PASS by moment (tap anywhere right also traps; double-tap PASS to loft it, drag off PASS for a through ball led that way) · SHOOT / SHOOT! / SLIDE · CROSS (hold it longer for a man further across; double-tap: a low driven cross) / CROSS! FORMATION FOR
PRACTICE:

Offside is on — forwards play on the shoulder of the last defender and slot into the gaps between markers, waiting to spring onto a through ball; stray beyond the line when the pass is played and it\u2019s a free kick the other way. Tactics for both teams (press / neutral / low block · neutral / wing / counter). L crosses when you have the ball, or requests a cross when you don\u2019t (a wide teammate whips it toward you); in your own half it clears instead (first time, no control needed) · J call/pass (double-tap for a lofted pass) · K shoot/header/command/tackle · J or SPACE switches player (towards the way you're pushing), or click one. FREE PLAY for shooting practice.
